items.text: Today, October 19, we released the controls update patch we announced earlier.
This update focuses on attack and lock-on controls, the areas players requested most.
The lock-on angle has been widened, making it easier to target enemies.
In addition, while locked on, your Labor will now turn in place to face the target, allowing you to track
enemies more intuitively.
This improvement applies to Assist, Normal, and Hard modes.
Babel mode retains its original specifications.
Enemy HP bars now indicate whether an enemy is "Lockable" or "Locked On."
This lets you see at a glance which enemy you're targeting, making combat smoother.
When you attack while holding the stick, your Labor will now turn toward the input direction before attacking.
If an enemy is near that direction, your Labor will automatically face it head-on before striking, making it easier to land hits on your intended target.

notes.title: ④ Ranged Weapon Lock-On(Assist Mode only)

items.text: You can now lock on with a single button press when using ranged weapons.
Locking on turns not only the camera but also your Labor itself toward the target, making it easier to aim during ranged combat.
This feature is only available when Assist Mode is enabled.
The lock-on tutorial now visually displays the actual lock-on range.
The aiming tutorial has also been revised so that you practice aiming and firing before moving on.
This makes the controls easier to learn for players who are just getting started.
We are currently working on improvements to make the game more comfortable and enjoyable to play, with a particular focus on gameplay controls.
In response to the feedback we have received regarding attack and lock-on controls, we would like to share the improvements currently planned for a future update.
We are expanding the effective angle of the lock-on system to make it easier to lock onto enemies.
In addition, while locked on, your Labor will turn toward the target in place, allowing you to track and engage enemies more intuitively.
This improvement is planned for Assist, Normal, and Hard modes.
The current lock-on specifications will remain unchanged in Babel Mode.
When attacking while holding a direction on the stick, your Labor will first turn toward the direction you are aiming before performing the attack.
In addition, if an enemy is near the direction you are aiming, the Labor will automatically face the enemy before attacking, making it easier to hit your intended target more intuitively.

notes.title: ③ Lock-On Support for Ranged Weapons

items.text: We are working on an improvement that will allow you to lock onto enemies with a single button press while using ranged weapons.
When locked on, not only the camera but also your Labor itself will turn toward the target, making it easier to aim during ranged combat.
We will add indicators to enemy HP bars to clearly show when an enemy can be locked on and when they are currently locked on.
This improvement is intended to make combat easier to understand and navigate.
For the lock-on tutorial, we are working on an improvement that will visually display the actual effective range of the lock-on system.
For the aiming tutorial, we will revise the explanation to demonstrate the actual process of aiming and firing, allowing players to experience the aiming controls before proceeding.
We plan to continue making improvements, with a particular focus on gameplay controls.
